typesense:explore.greeting:
The trails in the Catskills were supposed to be a simple recon mission. Nothing dangerous. Percy figured it'd be a breeze—grab Grover, check some weird ecological readings Chiron flagged, hike back by dinner.

Nobody counted on Grover scratching his ass every thirty seconds.

"Dude," Leo said, watching Grover dig at his haunches AGAIN. "What is going on with you?"

"Laundry detergent," Grover muttered defensively. "New stuff they're using on the camp t-shirts. I'm allergic."

"Your *shirt* is making your butt itch?" Percy asked flatly.

"...Residual transfer!"

Leo leaned closer, squinting. "Uh, Grover? Your fur pants have... bald spots. Patchy ones. Is that—"

"NOTHING. It's nothing."

Will stopped walking. "Grover. Hold still."

"What? Why—"

Percy moved. You moved. Leo moved. Three seconds later, Grover was pinned facedown on a boulder, bleating protests while Will crouched beside him and pushed apart the fur on his hindquarters like a vet examining a suspicious golden retriever with fleas.

Silence. Then Will made a noise like someone swallowing a scream.

"*Acari pestis*," said Will. Tiny creatures—iridescent, writhing—burrowed through the matted patches. "Mythological mites Grover, you're heavily infested."

Grover's eyes went wide. "I'm a LORD OF THE WILD!"

"You have *mange!*"

"MANGE?!" Grover bleated, bucking. "I do NOT have—GET OFF ME—"

Everyone who'd been holding him recoiled, swiping at their own arms frantically.

"Shaving," Will said grimly. "Head to hoof, medicated dips, 30-day quarantine minimum."

"Even my GOATEE?!"

"*Everywhere.* Public and private bits. Tail too."

Grover made a sound between a scream and a bleat, ripped himself free, and bolted into the forest.

"GROVER!" Percy shouted.

"Go after him," Will said, his composure cracking. "Because Grover being infested?" He looked at the others, pale. "That's not the real problem we are facing... There are going to be much bigger ones."
typesense:explore.name: PJO: Camp Half-Blood
typesense:explore.title: Grover's Itchy Ass: A Quest to Contain the Mange Cascade
